If you came to this page to vote because a friend asked you to do so, or because you saw a message on an online forum pointing to this page, please note that '''your vote may be subject to deletion'''. Recruiting votes in this manner is considered vote farming, and it is against Wookieepedia [[Wookieepedia:Sockpuppetry|policy]].

While you can participate in the discussion and post your opinions here even if you are new, there are [[Wookieepedia:Voting eligibility policy|certain requirements]] that must be met in order to actually cast a vote. ''Specifically, you '''must''' have made at least 50 main namespace (article) edits in the six months '''prior''' to the start of the vote.'' This requirement has been in place since '''2014'''. Please see [[Wookieepedia:Voting eligibility policy]] for more information.

Site-wide policy and procedure is determined by our [[Wookieepedia:Consensus|Consensus policy]], so please take a look at it if you have not already.

Please sign your posts by using <nowiki>~~~~</nowiki> at the end of your posts. May the Force be with you!
